001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events;
002
003import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
004import java.util.Set;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.EveryFrameScript;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.StarSystemAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.comm.IntelInfoPlugin;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Industries;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.SystemBountyIntel;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
016
017public class CommerceBountyManager implements EveryFrameScript {
018
019        protected IntervalUtil tracker = new IntervalUtil(0.5f, 1.5f);
020        
021        public boolean isDone() {
022                return false;
023        }
024
025        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
026                return false;
027        }
028
029        public void advance(float amount) {
030                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
031                tracker.advance(days);
032                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
033//                      HostileActivityEventIntel ha = HostileActivityEventIntel.get();
034//                      if (ha == null) return;
035                        
036                        //boolean haLevelSufficient = ha.isStageActive(Stage.HA_1);
037                        boolean haLevelSufficient = true;
038                        
039                        Set<StarSystemAPI> seen = new LinkedHashSet<>();
040                        for (StarSystemAPI system : Misc.getPlayerSystems(false)) {
041                                seen.add(system);
042                                SystemBountyIntel bounty = getCommerceBounty(system);
043                                if (bounty != null && bounty.isEnding()) continue;
044                                
045                                boolean hasFunctionalCommerce = doesStarSystemHavePlayerCommerceIndustry(system, true);
046                                boolean hasCommerce = doesStarSystemHavePlayerCommerceIndustry(system, false);
047                        
048                                if (bounty != null && (!hasCommerce || !haLevelSufficient)) {
049                                        bounty.endAfterDelay();
050                                        continue;
051                                }
052                                
053                                MarketAPI market = getPlayerCommerceMarket(system);
054                                if (market == null) continue;
055                                
056                                if (bounty == null && hasFunctionalCommerce && haLevelSufficient) {
057                                        float reward = Global.getSettings().getFloat("baseCommerceSystemBounty");
058                                        new SystemBountyIntel(market, (int) reward, true);
059                                } 
060                        }
061
062                        // cancel commerce bounties where a market is no longer present
063                        for (IntelInfoPlugin curr : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(SystemBountyIntel.class)) {
064                                SystemBountyIntel intel = (SystemBountyIntel) curr;
065                                if (!intel.isCommerceMode()) continue;
066                                if (intel.isEnding() || intel.isEnded()) continue;
067                                if (seen.contains(intel.getLocation())) continue;
068                                intel.endAfterDelay();
069                        }
070                }
071        }
072        
073        public static SystemBountyIntel getCommerceBounty(StarSystemAPI system) {
074                for (IntelInfoPlugin curr : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(SystemBountyIntel.class)) {
075                        SystemBountyIntel intel = (SystemBountyIntel) curr;
076                        if (intel.getLocation() == system && intel.isCommerceMode()) return intel;
077                }
078                return null;
079        }
080        public static boolean doesStarSystemHavePlayerCommerceIndustry(StarSystemAPI system, boolean requireFunctional) {
081                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getMarketsInLocation(system, Factions.PLAYER)) {
082                        if (requireFunctional && market.hasFunctionalIndustry(Industries.COMMERCE)) {
083                                return true;
084                        }
085                        if (!requireFunctional && market.hasIndustry(Industries.COMMERCE)) {
086                                return true;
087                        }
088                }
089                return false;
090        }
091        public static MarketAPI getPlayerCommerceMarket(StarSystemAPI system) {
092                MarketAPI best = null;
093                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getMarketsInLocation(system, Factions.PLAYER)) {
094                        if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.COMMERCE)) {
095                                if (best == null || best.getSize() < market.getSize()) {
096                                        best = market;
097                                }
098                        }
099                }
100                return best;
101        }
102
103}
